title: Effectiveness of Different Candies Against Bad Breath
brief_summary: This study is to analyze whether the candies can relieve or eliminate bad breath, both subjectively and objectively.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Non- smoker
* No general medical illness or medication

Exclusion Criteria:

* Allergies/intolerances to ingredients of the products used
* Chronic diseases
* Smoker
* Pregnancy
